backup.title: Key backup
backup.enabledHint: The master key is already backed up. You can change the password or delete the backup.
backup.warningMessage: If you do not set a recovery password, all old messages will become impossible to decrypt when you log in on a new device, change your browser, or clear your cache.
backup.warningNoRecovery: The password cannot be recovered. If you forget it, your encrypted messages are lost forever.
backup.staleKey: This device has an outdated key. Restore the current key from the backup first.
backup.staleHint: The server backup version does not match the local key. Restore the current key or save the password again from this device.
backup.recoveryStale: The backup belongs to a different key version. Reload the page and restore the current backup.
backup.needLocalKey: You need to have your local encryption key to manage the backup. If you are on a new device, use the recovery prompt instead.
backup.deleteConfirm: Delete the recovery backup? Old messages can no longer be restored on a new device.
backup.doneEnabled: Your recovery backup has been saved on the server.
backup.doneDisabled: Your recovery backup has been removed.
backup.recoveryPrompt: This account's messages are encrypted with a key that is not on this device. Enter your recovery password to restore access to your old messages.
backup.recoveryDeclineLock: PIN/passkey protection will be disabled, and local keys and history on this device will be deleted. Continue?
backup.recoveryDeclineConfirm: The server backup and local history will be permanently deleted and a new key will be created. Continue?
backup.recoveryDeclineIdentity: A new signing key will be created. Contacts that already trusted the old key will stop accepting your messages until they verify the new one. Continue?
backup.recoveryWrongPassword: Wrong password. The keys could not be recovered.
backup.multiDeviceTitle: A key from another device is required
backup.multiDevicePrompt: This account has other active devices, but this device has no encryption key and no backup.
backup.multiDeviceWarning: Creating a new key here would make the other devices unable to read new messages.
backup.multiDeviceAdvice: Open the app on another device, enable the key backup, then return here. If you cannot access the other devices, sign out everywhere to create a new key; old history will stay unreadable.
backup.newKeyPrompt: This device has no encryption key and no backup.
backup.newKeyWarning: A new key cannot decrypt the old history. This cannot be undone.
backup.newKeyAdvice: If another device still has the key, enable its backup and recover there first. Continue only if you accept losing access to old messages.
backup.unknownHint: The server did not answer, so the backup state is unknown. This is not the same as having no backup. Check the connection and retry before deleting anything.
backup.identityReplaceAlertTitle: Contacts will stop trusting this account
backup.identityReplacePrompt: This device has no encryption key, but the server still publishes the identity your contacts pinned.
backup.identityReplaceWarning: A new identity is not signed by the old one. Contacts that pinned it will reject every future message from this account, while you keep reading your own messages without noticing.
backup.identityReplaceAdvice: Recover the key from the backup instead. Continue only if the old key is lost for good and you accept that contacts must verify the new identity.
backup.recoveryRemovesLock: Recovering a server backup removes the local PIN/passkey protection on this device: the restored key does not match the old wrapper. Enable the local lock again after recovery.

localLock.title: Local PIN lock
localLock.hint: Wrap the local master key with a 6-digit PIN. The server backup password stays separate.
localLock.enabledHint: Local keys are encrypted at rest. Enter the PIN after a restart or auto-lock.
localLock.lockedHint: Enter the 6-digit PIN to decrypt the local master key.
localLock.forgotConfirm: Remove the local keys from this device? They can be recovered from the server backup with the password or passkey.
localLock.forgotNoBackup: No server backup was found. Removing the local keys will permanently lose message history. Continue?
localLock.forgotStale: The server backup is outdated and does not match the current key. After removing the local keys a new key will be required and old history will be lost. Continue?
localLock.error.passkeyUnavailable: Passkeys are not available in this browser.
localLock.error.backupPasswordFirst: Save the server backup password first.
localLock.error.failed: Could not change the local protection.
localLock.error.backupUnknown: Could not check the server backup. Connect to the network and retry; deleting keys now is unsafe.
localLock.error.prfUnsupported: This password manager doesn't support PRF. Use a built-in passkey or PIN.
localLock.error.prfMissing: The passkey didn't return a PRF key.
localLock.error.prfUnstable: The passkey returned an unstable key and is not usable.
localLock.error.weakPin: This PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid repeated digits and sequences.
localLock.error.throttled: Too many wrong attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
localLock.needBackup: Save and enable the server recovery backup first. Without it a forgotten PIN permanently loses your message history.
localLock.disableConfirm: Disable the PIN? The master key will be stored unencrypted in this browser's IndexedDB again.
localLock.corruptPin: The local PIN blob is damaged or uses an unsupported format. Use recovery from the server backup.
localLock.passkeyFailedHint: Passkey unlock failed. Try the PIN instead or re-enable the passkey after unlocking.
localLock.forgotGeneric: Lost the passkey? Recover from backup
localLock.recipientKeyChanged: The encryption key of a contact changed. This is normal after a rotation, but if you did not expect it, verify the contact out of band before sending secrets.
localLock.webLocksMissing: This browser has no Web Locks API. Cross-tab key protection is weaker: keep a single tab open while creating, rotating or restoring keys.
localLock.pinThreatModel: The PIN protects against someone glancing at the screen or briefly using the device. It does not stop an attacker who can copy the browser profile: a 6-digit PIN is brute-forced offline, so use a device passcode and disk encryption as well.
localLock.background: Lock when tab goes to background
localLock.serverPasskeyEnable: Also protect the server backup with passkey
localLock.serverPasskeyEnabled: Server backup is also protected by passkey
localLock.serverPasskeyDisable: Remove passkey protection from the server backup
rotation.title: Key rotation
rotation.hint: The new key is stored in the password/passkey backup. Other devices need the backup password or passkey to fetch it.
rotation.signingWarning: Signing-key rotation changes how contacts verify your messages: they will need to trust the new key. Old messages stay signed by the previous key.
rotation.passkeyHint: The server backup is protected by a passkey. Disable that protection before rotating, otherwise the new key cannot be recovered with the password alone.
rotation.error.lockActive: Disable the PIN/passkey first: rotation is not allowed while a local lock is enabled.
rotation.error.passkeyBackup: Disable the passkey protection of the server backup first.
rotation.error.badPassword: Wrong backup password, or the backup has not been created yet.
rotation.error.stale: This device has an outdated key. Restore the current key from the backup first.
rotation.error.publish: The new key was created locally but the server rejected it. Retry later or restore the backup.
rotation.error.backupNotSaved: The key was rotated, but the backup was not saved. Open backup settings and save the password again.
